title: A quasi-compact scheme has a finite affine open cover
statement: Let $T$ be a quasi-compact scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. There are finitely many affine open subschemes $T_1,\ldots,T_m\subseteq T$ such that $T=\bigcup_{j=1}^mT_j$.
